title: Clay Relationship Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: Monica contacts (`monica:contact`), Clay relationships (`clay:relationship`), LinkedIn connections (`linkedin:connection`), follow-up reminders (`followup:reminder`), and intro requests (`intro:request`).
app: Monica contact relationship logs, Clay network exports, LinkedIn connection events, follow-up reminder tasks, and warm-intro request trackers streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=clay:relationship
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by network_segment
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>168
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when Clay relationship data has stopped arriving for a given network segment.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per network segment and alert when the feed is older than 168 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It measures when one part of your Clay relationship feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
